name: Siren Head Dating Sim
source:
Have you ever looked at Siren Head and think "Man. I sure would love to date him."

WELL NOW YOU CAN!

Check out Siren Head Dating Sim to have a magical day with Siren Head!

Just make sure you don't get killed.

WARNING!: This game has loud sounds.

Siren Head made by: Trevor Henderson

[From [url=https://nekosounds.itch.io/siren-head-dating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]
